Based on the original work from Arnd Bergmann.
When XFRM_ALGO is not enabled
column2: the new ixgbe IPsec code produces a

column1: link error:
drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ixgbe/ixgbe_ipsec.o: In function `ixgbe_ipsec_vf_add_sa':
ixgbe_ipsec.c:(.text+0x1266): undefined reference to `xfrm_aead_get_byname'
Simply selecting XFRM_ALGO from here causes circular dependencies
to fix it
column2: we probably want this slightly more complex solution that is

column1: similar to what other drivers with XFRM offload do:
A separate Kconfig symbol now controls whether we include the IPsec
offload code. To keep the old behavior
column2: this is left as 'default y'. The

column1: dependency in XFRM_OFFLOAD still causes a circular dependency but is
not actually needed because this symbol is not user visible
that dependency on top makes it all work.
